scope: source-locked translation of the published sequential 3-D inspection ordering core; not a claim that the upstream code supplies four-UAV control or hidden-target search

adapter.implementation: faithful translation of CreateModel.m, TourCost.m, and the fixed ACO loop; MATLAB/Octave was unavailable on the benchmark host

g2_i_mapping: each drone receives only its pre-frozen, target-independent public sector cells
cell positions instantiate the upstream three-dimensional point set
the source movement-cost formula orders cells within that public sector
the shared benchmark executor owns all CF2X motion, observation, safety, anonymous receipt, and return behavior
forbidden_inputs: private mesh, rendered depth, or evaluator rays

known_limitations: The locked source implementation optimizes one sequential tour; it does not allocate work among four vehicles.
G2-I's public mission-sector assignment therefore remains a benchmark contract rather than an upstream multi-UAV allocation result.
This translation is a development candidate until a source-equivalence fixture and a three-ancestor L0/L1 panel succeed.
It must not close Gate C, authorize formal-test access, or be presented as a native MATLAB upstream execution.
